# Wiggins

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Wiggins is known for an extreme degree of frugality. According to local accounts, he goes so far as to sell off all possible produce and goods from his property, raising his family on skim milk.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)_

## Traits

- presumed frugal to excess  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>

## History

Wiggins is a caterpillar involved in a church disturbance caused by [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md). During a Sunday service, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) drops Wiggins down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck, creating a commotion.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +56 more_
